```{r estrobolome targets, control ids, WGS filter}
## Estrobolome data

## List of Plate_IDs for Control Samples
technical_ids <- c("GMBC_00307","GMBC_00412","GMBC_00408", #plate1 012_T1-T3
                   "GMBC_00617","GMBC_00911","GMBC_00807", #plate2 079_T1-T3
                   "GMBC_01204","GMBC_01216","GMBC_01120", #plate3 023_T1-T3 (part 2)
                  "GMBC_01401","GMBC_01315","GMBC_01415",#plate4 012_T4-T6
                  "GMBC_01403","GMBC_01310","GMBC_01402", #plate4 079_T4-T6
                  "GMBC_01409","GMBC_01314","GMBC_01407") #plate4 023_T4-T6.P1 (part 1)

control_ids <- c("GMBC_00508","GMBC_00609","GMBC_00723","GMBC_00416", #plate1 NC_01-04
                  "GMBC_00212","GMBC_00801","GMBC_00305","GMBC_00902", #plate2 NC_05-08
                  "GMBC_01002","GMBC_01114","GMBC_01201", #plate3 NC_09-11
                  "GMBC_01414","GMBC_01317") #plate4 NC_12,NC_13


## Filter WGS data by a meta (epi) variable 
wgs_filter <- function(data, variable, var_value) {
  #convert alpha to a symbol for NSE
  alpha <- rlang::ensym(variable)
  #data modifications
  gmbc_data %>% 
    filter(!is.na(plate_ID)) %>%
    #pull out needed meta from gmbc_data
    select(plate_ID, !!alpha) %>%
    #add onto the metaphlan data
    merge(x=data, y=., by="plate_ID", all.x=TRUE) %>%
    #filter by the added meta variable
    filter(!!alpha==var_value) %>% 
    #drop meta var so only meteagenomic
    select(-!!alpha)
}


## Filter metabolite data by collection part
metabo_filter.p1 <- function(metabo_data) {
  metabo_data %>%
    merge(gmbc_data %>% select(study_id, collection_part), by = "study_id", all.x = TRUE) %>%
    filter(collection_part == "1") %>%
    select(-collection_part)
}
``` 

gmbc_data (REDCap, CDHQIII)              
```{r gmbc_data read in, impute}
 
#Read in gmbc_data from Data Cleaning.Rmd  
gmbc_data <- read.csv("gmbc_data_2025-08-22.csv") %>% 
  #ONLY INCLUDE INDIVIDUALS WITH BASELINE + FU DATA AVAILABLE
  drop_na(plate_ID) %>% #drops the 4 missing fu vals
  filter(!study_id %in% c("GMBC_043","GMBC_069","GMBC_120","GMBC_134")) #drops the part 1 vals

## Converting Data to Factor
gmbc_data <- gmbc_data %>%
  mutate(
    #selecting redcap variables only
      across(
      .cols = study_id:t_biol.occur,
      .fns = ~ if (!(cur_column() %in% 
              #numerical variables (for NOT in this list)
              c("s_age","s_height_cm","s_bmi","d_household_adults", "d_household_children","METmin",
              "rh_menarchy_age","s_menopause_age","rh_contraceptive_totalyr","rh_pregnancy_num",
              "rh_pregnancy_live","rh_pregnancy_age_first","rh_breastfeed_months",
               "rh_pregnancy_age_last","t_diameter.avg",
              "serum1_hours.diff","stool1_hours.diff","serum2_hours.diff",
              "stool2_hours.diff","stool_serum1.diff","stool_serum2.diff") 
        )) {
          as.factor(.)
        } else {
          .
        }
    ),
  #re-leveling factors
  ethnic_collapsed = factor(ethnic_collapsed, 
      levels = c("White","Asian","Other")),
  d_education_collapsed = factor(d_education_collapsed, 
    levels = c("<= High school","Post-high school training","Bachelor's","Postgraduate")),
  d_income_collapsed = factor(d_income_collapsed, 
      levels = c("49k","50k","100k","150k","PNA")) 
  )

## Updating GMBC variables for adjustment
gmbc_data <- gmbc_data %>% 
  mutate(
    #updates for control who became a case
    plate_ID = case_when(
      study_id == "GMBC_048" ~ "GMBC_00803", #first sample becomes 2nd run
      study_id == "GMBC_048_E2" ~ "GMBC_01318", #second sample becomes 3rd run
      TRUE ~ plate_ID ),
    #age at first pregnancy
    rh_pregnancy_age_first_cat = case_when(
        (rh_pregnancy_age_first >= 30) ~ as.factor(3), #geriatric pregnancy
        (rh_pregnancy_age_first < 30 & rh_pregnancy_age_first >= 25) ~ as.factor(2),
        (rh_pregnancy_age_first < 25) ~ as.factor(1),
        TRUE ~ as.factor(0) ),
    #smoking never / ever
    sm_summary = case_when(
        (sm_summary == 0) ~ as.factor(0),
        (sm_summary %in% c(1,2)) ~ as.factor(1),
        TRUE ~ NA ),
    #education level
    d_education_collapsed = case_when(
      (d_education_collapsed %in% c("<= High school","Post-high school training") ) ~ as.factor("< Bachelor's"),
      TRUE ~ d_education_collapsed ),
    d_education_collapsed = factor(d_education_collapsed), #refactor to collapse levels
    #ethnicity
    ethnic_collapsed = case_when(
      ethnic_collapsed %in% c("Asian","Other") ~ as.factor("Non-White"),
      TRUE ~ ethnic_collapsed),
    ethnic_collapsed = factor(ethnic_collapsed) #refactor to collapse levels
)


## Cleaning up the Follow-Up data
gmbc_data <- gmbc_data %>% 
  mutate(
    ## RADIATION
    t_rad.cat = case_when(
      t_rads.occur == 1 ~ "Yes",
      t_rads.occur == 0 ~ "No",
      is.na(t_rads.occur) ~ "Control"
     ),
    ## CHEMOTHERAPY
    t_chemo.cat = case_when(
      t_chemo.occur == 1 ~ "Yes",
      t_chemo.occur == 0 ~ "No",
      is.na(t_chemo.occur) ~ "Control"
     ),
    ## ENDOCRINE THERAPY
    t_endo.cat = case_when(
      t_endo.occur == 1 ~ "Yes",
      t_endo.occur == 0 ~ "No",
      is.na(t_endo.occur) ~ "Control"
     ),
    t_endo_drug.tamoxifen = case_when(
      t_endo.cat == "Control" ~ "Control",
      #088 switched to tamoxifen AFTER sample collection
      #135 was only briefly on tamoxifen between two different AIs
      study_id %in% c("GMBC_088","GMBC_088_E2","GMBC_135","GMBC_135_E2") ~ "No",
      t_endo.cat == "Yes" & t_endo_drug___1 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    t_endo_drug.arominhib = case_when(
      t_endo.cat == "Control" ~ "Control",
      #088 switched to tamoxifen AFTER sample collection
      #135 was only briefly on tamoxifen between two different AIs
      study_id %in% c("GMBC_088","GMBC_088_E2","GMBC_135","GMBC_135_E2") ~ "Yes",
      t_endo.cat == "Yes" & t_endo_drug___2 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      t_endo.cat == "Yes" & t_endo_drug___3 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      t_endo.cat == "Yes" & t_endo_drug___4 == 1 ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    t_endo_drug.cat= case_when(
      t_endo.cat == "Control" ~ "Control",
      t_endo_drug.tamoxifen == "Yes" ~ "Tamoxifen",
      t_endo_drug.arominhib == "Yes" ~ "Aromatase_inhibitor",
      TRUE ~ "None"
    ),
    t_endo_current.cat = case_when(
      t_endo.cat == "Control" ~ "Control",
      t_endo.cat == "No" ~ "None",
      study_id %in% c("GMBC_009","GMBC_009_E2","GMBC_037","GMBC_037_E2",
                      "GMBC_098","GMBC_098_E2","GMBC_134","GMBC_134_E2") ~ "No",
      study_id %in% c("GMBC_102","GMBC_102_E2") ~ "Yes",
      t_endo_current == 1 ~ "Yes",
      t_endo_current == 0 ~ "No"
    ),
    
    ## BISPHOSPHATES
    t_bisp.cat = case_when(
      t_bisp.occur == 1 ~ "Yes",
      t_bisp.occur == 0 ~ "No",
      is.na(t_bisp.occur) ~ "Control"
     ),
    
    ## ANTIBIOTICS FU
    fu_antibiotic.clean = ifelse( (fu_antibiotic == 1 | t_antibiotics == 1), 1, 0),
    fu_antibiotic.clean = ifelse( is.na(fu_antibiotic.clean), 0, fu_antibiotic.clean),
    fu_antibiotic.clean = as.factor(fu_antibiotic.clean)
  )


## There is a case who's chemo was misinterpreted
gmbc_data$t_chemo[which(gmbc_data$study_id == "GMBC_020")] <- 0 #chemo 1 to 0
gmbc_data$t_bisp[which(gmbc_data$study_id == "GMBC_020")] <- 1 # add in bisp
``` 

MetaPhlAn4 (stool)        
```{r metaphlan data read and cleaning}

## Read in the data
metaphlan4_all <- 
  #force three cols to properly read in
  read.table("profiled_metagenome.tsv", sep = "\t", fill = TRUE, col.names = c("plate_ID", "clade_name", "clade_taxid", "relative_abundance", "coverage", "estimated_number_of_reads_from_the_clade"), quote = "", comment.char = "") %>%
  #drop front matter
  slice(-(1:329)) %>% 
  mutate(name = str_extract(clade_name, "[^|]+$"),
         #need to convert to numeric
         across(relative_abundance:estimated_number_of_reads_from_the_clade, as.numeric)) %>% 
  #derive rank
  mutate(rank = case_when(
    grepl("k__", name) ~ "kingdom",
    grepl("p__", name) ~ "phylum",
    grepl("c__", name) ~ "class",
    grepl("o__", name) ~ "order",
    grepl("f__", name) ~ "family",
    grepl("g__", name) ~ "genus",
    grepl("s__", name) ~ "species",
    grepl("t__", name) ~ "subspecies",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  ))


## Data Selection

#Data selection
metaphlan4 <- metaphlan4_all %>% 
  # Drop the negative and technical controls
  filter(!plate_ID %in% control_ids) %>%
  filter(!plate_ID %in% technical_ids) %>% 
  # Drop those with NO part 2 DATA!
  filter(!plate_ID %in% c("GMBC_00615","GMBC_00203","GMBC_01104","GMBC_01223"))

#The third percentile of data = 0.00078
min_abundance_threshold <- quantile(metaphlan4 %>% pull(relative_abundance), probs = 0.03)

#Calculating frequency of taxa present
filtered_taxa <- metaphlan4 %>%
  #binary presence/absence matrix
  mutate(presence = ifelse(is.na(relative_abundance), FALSE, relative_abundance > min_abundance_threshold)) %>% #0
  #calc presence frequency for each taxon
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarize(
    presence_count = sum(presence), #243 is the max (should be 241?)
    frequency = presence_count / n_distinct(metaphlan4$plate_ID) #presence/total count to get %
  )
#Filter taxa based on prevalence thresholds
filtered_taxa10 <- filtered_taxa %>% filter(frequency >= 0.1) %>% pull(name)

#Data Filtering 
metaphlan4_long <- metaphlan4 %>%
  filter(name %in% filtered_taxa10) %>% 
  arrange(plate_ID)


## Rename the subspecies to include the species in the name (more informative)
metaphlan4_long <- metaphlan4_long %>% 
  mutate(name = if_else( rank == "subspecies", #if subspecies level
                         str_extract(clade_name, "s__[^|]+\\|t__[^|]+"), #rename to include species
                         name) ) #otherwise leave


## Transforming to wider form
metaphlan4_wide <- metaphlan4_long %>% 
  filter(rank %in% c("species","genus","subspecies")) %>%
  pivot_wider(., 
    id_cols=c(plate_ID), #sample stays as row
    names_from=name, #name becomes column with rel abun as value
    values_from=relative_abundance,
    values_fill = 0)  #covert NA relative abundance to 0s

## Transforming to wider form for SPECIES data
metaphlan4_wide.s <- metaphlan4_long %>% 
  filter(rank=="species") %>%
  pivot_wider(., 
    id_cols=c(plate_ID), #sample stays as row
    names_from=name, #name becomes column with rel abun as value
    values_from=relative_abundance,
    values_fill = 0)  #covert NA relative abundance to 0s

## Transforming to wider form for SUBSPECIES data
metaphlan4_wide.t <- metaphlan4_long %>% 
  filter(rank=="subspecies") %>%
  pivot_wider(., 
    id_cols=c(plate_ID), #sample stays as row
    names_from=name, #name becomes column with rel abun as value
    values_from=relative_abundance,
    values_fill = 0)  #covert NA relative abundance to 0s

## Transforming to wider form for GENUS data
metaphlan4_wide.g <- metaphlan4_long %>% 
  filter(rank=="genus") %>%
  pivot_wider(., 
    id_cols=c(plate_ID), #sample stays as row
    names_from=name, #name becomes column with rel abun as value
    values_from=relative_abundance,
    values_fill = 0)  #covert NA relative abundance to 0s


```   

HUMAnN3 (stool) 
```{r humann.path_nopipe read in}

## Read In File
humann.path_nopipe <- read.csv("humann.path_nopipe_2025-04-15.csv") %>% 
  rename(relative_abundance = value)  %>% 
  # Remove controls
  filter(!plate_ID%in%technical_ids) %>% #tech ids
  filter(!plate_ID%in%control_ids) %>%  #neg con
  # Drop those with NO part 2 DATA!
  filter(!plate_ID %in% c("GMBC_00615","GMBC_00203","GMBC_01104","GMBC_01223"))


## Data Filtering

#third percentile of data = 8.399325e-07(Robertson 3 × 10−7% = 0.000000003)
min_abundance_threshold <- humann.path_nopipe %>% 
  filter(!name %in% c("UNMAPPED","UNINTEGRATED")) %>% 
  pull(relative_abundance) %>% 
  quantile(., probs = 0.03)


#calculating frequency of taxa present
filtered_path5 <- humann.path_nopipe %>%
  #binary presence/absence matrix
  mutate(presence = ifelse(is.na(relative_abundance), FALSE, relative_abundance > min_abundance_threshold)) %>%
  #calc presence frequency for each taxon
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarize(
    presence_count = sum(presence),  #243 is the max (should be 241?)
    #presence/total count to get %
    frequency = presence_count / n_distinct(humann.path_nopipe$plate_ID)
  ) %>%
  #filter taxa based on the 5% threshold
  filter(frequency >= 0.05) %>%
  #pull out names
  pull(name)


#apply
humann.path_long <- humann.path_nopipe %>% 
  #remove unintegrated and unmapped samples
  filter(!name %in% c("UNMAPPED","UNINTEGRATED")) %>% 
  #filtering dataframe for >5% frequency
  filter(name %in% filtered_path5)

## Transforming to wider form
humann.path_wide <- humann.path_long %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c(plate_ID), #sample stays as row
              names_from=name, #name becomes column with rel abun as value
              values_from=relative_abundance,
              values_fill = 0)  #covert NA relative abundance to 0s


``` 

```{r humann.enzymes_nopipe read and clean}

## Read and Clean

#Read in nopipe data and clean
humann.enzymes_nopipe <- read.csv("genefamilies_relab_ec_cleaned_2025-01-03.csv") %>% 
  # Remove control samples
  filter(!plate_ID%in%technical_ids) %>% #tech ids
  filter(!plate_ID%in%control_ids) %>%  #neg con
  # Drop those with NO part 2 DATA!
  filter(!plate_ID %in% c("GMBC_00615","GMBC_00203","GMBC_01104","GMBC_01223")) %>% 
  ## Merge Name codes in
  merge(.,
        read.delim("map_ec_name.txt", header = FALSE) %>%
        rename(name = V1, Enzyme_name = V2),
        by = "name") %>% 
  # convert to numeric
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value)) %>% 
  #rename
  rename(relative_abundance = value)
  

## Data Filtering

#third percentile of data
min_abundance_threshold <- quantile(humann.enzymes_nopipe %>% pull(relative_abundance), probs = 0.03)

#calculating frequency of taxa present
filtered_enzyme5 <- humann.enzymes_nopipe %>%
  #binary presence/absence matrix
  mutate(presence = ifelse(is.na(relative_abundance), FALSE, relative_abundance > min_abundance_threshold)) %>%
  #calc presence frequency for each taxon
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarize(
    presence_count = sum(presence),
    #presence/total count to get %
    frequency = presence_count / n_distinct(humann.enzymes_nopipe$plate_ID)
  ) %>% 
  #filter taxa based on the 5% threshold
  filter(frequency >= 0.05) %>%
  #pull out names
  pull(name)

#applying
humann.enzymes_long <- humann.enzymes_nopipe %>%
  #filtering dataframe for >5% frequency
  filter(name %in% filtered_enzyme5)

## Transforming to wider form
humann.enzymes_wide <- humann.enzymes_long %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(plate_ID), #sample stays as row
              names_from = name, #Enzyme name has special characters that crash
              values_from = relative_abundance,
              values_fill = 0)  #covert NA relative abundance to 0s
```

Metabolomics (blood & stool)   
```{r metabo plasma - reading and cleaning}

library(openxlsx)

#Set Pathway (file with multiple sheets)
pathway <- "GMBC_Metabolite_Results_2025-04-30.xlsx"

#Read in Metabolite Class Info
metabo_class <- read.xlsx(pathway, sheet = 4) %>%
  select(Class, Metabolite) %>% 
  #replace " " with "." to match
  mutate(Metabolite.match = gsub(" ", ".", Metabolite))
  
#Read in metabolomics abundances
plasma_abund <- read.xlsx(pathway, sheet = 1) 

#Clean up the study codes
plasma_abund <- plasma_abund %>% 
  rename(study_id = "Sample_ID") %>% 
  #remove the added front code
  mutate(study_id =   gsub("^\\d{3}_", "", study_id)) %>% 
  #ensure numeric
  mutate(across(-study_id, as.numeric) ) %>% 
  #removing those who have part 2 but no p1
  filter(!study_id %in% c("GMBC_049_E2","GMBC_137_E2")) %>% 
  #removing those who have p1 but no p2
  filter(!study_id %in% c("GMBC_028","GMBC_043","GMBC_069","GMBC_074","GMBC_120","GMBC_134"))

## Calculating prevalence frequency of metabolites present
filtered_metabo10 <- plasma_abund %>%
  pivot_longer(-study_id, names_to = "Metabolite", values_to = "relab") %>%
  mutate(presence = ifelse(is.na(relab), FALSE, relab > 0)) %>%
  group_by(Metabolite) %>%
  summarize(frequency = sum(presence) / n_distinct(plasma_abund$study_id)) %>%
  filter(frequency >= 0.10) %>%
  pull(Metabolite)


## Data Filtering >10% prevalence frequency (metabo_wide is filtered)
metabo.plasma_wide <- plasma_abund %>%
  select(study_id, all_of(filtered_metabo10)) %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% select(study_id), by="study_id", all.x=T)

## Long form data
metabo.plasma_long <- metabo.plasma_wide %>% 
  pivot_longer(-study_id, names_to = "Metabolite", values_to = "relative_abundance")


``` 
 
```{r metabo stool - reading and cleaning}

library(openxlsx)

#Set Pathway (file with multiple sheets)
pathway <- "GMBC_Metabolite_Results_2025-04-30.xlsx"

#Read in Metabolite Class Info
stool_abund <- read.xlsx(pathway, sheet = 3)

#Clean up the study codes
stool_abund <- stool_abund %>%
  rename(study_id = "Sample_ID") %>% 
  #remove the added front code
  mutate(study_id =   gsub("^\\d{3}_", "", study_id)) %>% 
  #ensure numeric
  mutate(across("Fecal.wet.mass.(mg)":"Zymosterol", as.numeric) ) %>% 
  select(!c("Fecal.wet.mass.(mg)","Extractant.volume.(mL)","Dry.mass.(mg)")) %>% 
  #remove those missing follow-up data
  filter(!study_id %in% c("GMBC_043","GMBC_069","GMBC_120","GMBC_134",
    #missing p1
    "GMBC_011_E2"))


## Calculating prevalence frequency of metabolites present
filtered_metabo10 <- stool_abund %>%
  pivot_longer(-study_id, names_to = "Metabolite", values_to = "relab") %>%
  mutate(presence = ifelse(is.na(relab), FALSE, relab > 0)) %>%
  group_by(Metabolite) %>%
  summarize(frequency = sum(presence) / n_distinct(stool_abund$study_id)) %>%
  filter(frequency >= 0.10) %>%
  pull(Metabolite)


## Data Filtering >10% prevalence frequency (metabo_wide is filtered)
metabo.stool_wide <- stool_abund %>%
  select(study_id, all_of(filtered_metabo10)) %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% select(study_id), by="study_id", all.x=T)

## Long form data
metabo.stool_long <- metabo.stool_wide %>% 
  pivot_longer(-study_id, names_to = "Metabolite", values_to = "relative_abundance")
``` 

# ANALYSES FUNCTIONS
      
Descriptive   
```{r alpha diversity functions }

#alpha is within sample diversity - what and how much is there in a sample
#beta is between sample diversity - how similar is one sample to another
 
## Calculate Alpha Diversity
alpha_calc_data <- function(data_long, metaphlan = FALSE) {
  
  ## Calculate alpha diversity as new cols
  alpha_data <- data_long %>% 
    #all species in a sample
    { if (metaphlan) filter(., rank == "subspecies") else . } %>%
    #plate_id is per sample at each time
    group_by(plate_ID) %>% 
    #calculate alpha metrics
    summarize(shannon = diversity(relative_abundance, "shannon"),
              richness = specnumber(relative_abundance)) %>% 
    #merge alpha metrics onto gmbc_data
    merge(gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, single_id, collection_part, case_con)
          , ., by="plate_ID", all.x = TRUE) 
  
  return (alpha_data) 
}
 
## Alpha Div Significant Testing

#cases v controls (wilcoxon rank sum)
alpha_sig_test.groups <- function(alpha_data, col_part) {

  #Filter which collection part
  alpha_data <- alpha_data %>% 
    filter(collection_part == col_part) %>% 
    drop_na()
  
  #SHANNON
  #calculate group medians alpha div
  meds <- alpha_data %>% 
    filter(shannon > 0) %>% #only include where alpha data
    group_by(case_con) %>% #group by cancer status
    summarise(median_alpha = median(shannon), .groups = "drop") #calculate group medians
  #calculating p values using wilcoxon rank sum test
  p.shannon <- wilcox.test(shannon ~ case_con, data = alpha_data%>%filter(shannon>0))
  #print out metrics
  print(glue("The group medians of SHANNON diversity:
           Controls = {meds$median_alpha[meds$case_con == 0]}
           Cases = {meds$median_alpha[meds$case_con == 1]}
           Abs median difference: {abs(diff(meds$median_alpha))}
           The p value (Wilcoxon): {p.shannon$p.value}"))

  #RICHNESS
  #calculate group medians alpha div
  meds <- alpha_data %>% 
    filter(richness > 0) %>% #only include where alpha data
    group_by(case_con) %>% #group by cancer status
    summarise(median_alpha = median(richness), .groups = "drop") #calculate group medians
  #calculating p values using wilcoxon rank sum test
  p.richness <- wilcox.test(richness ~ case_con, data = alpha_data%>%filter(richness>0))
  #print out metrics
  print(glue("The group medians of RICHNESS:
           Controls = {meds$median_alpha[meds$case_con == 0]}
           Cases = {meds$median_alpha[meds$case_con == 1]}
           Abs median difference: {abs(diff(meds$median_alpha))}
           The p value (Wilcoxon): {p.richness$p.value}"))
  
  return(list(p_shannon = p.shannon$p.value, 
            p_richness = p.richness$p.value)) 
}
#baseline v follow up (wilcoxon signed rank)
alpha_sig_test.paired <- function(alpha_data, group) {

  #Filter for whether looking in cases or controls
  alpha_data <- alpha_data %>% 
    filter(case_con == group) %>% 
    filter(shannon > 0, richness > 0)
  
  # Pivot to wide format for paired testing
  alpha_wide <- alpha_data %>%
    select(single_id, collection_part, shannon, richness) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = collection_part, values_from = c(shannon, richness), 
                names_prefix = "t")

  # Ensure both timepoints are present
  alpha_wide <- alpha_wide %>% 
    filter(!is.na(shannon_t1), !is.na(shannon_t2), 
           !is.na(richness_t1), !is.na(richness_t2))
  
  # SHANNON
  p.shannon <- wilcox.test(alpha_wide$shannon_t1, alpha_wide$shannon_t2, paired = TRUE)
  meds.shannon <- c(median(alpha_wide$shannon_t1), median(alpha_wide$shannon_t2))
  print(glue(
    "The group medians of SHANNON diversity:
     Baseline = {meds.shannon[1]}
     Follow up = {meds.shannon[2]}
     Abs median difference: {abs(diff(meds.shannon))}
     The p value (Wilcoxon-paired): {p.shannon$p.value}"
  ))

  # RICHNESS
  p.richness <- wilcox.test(alpha_wide$richness_t1, alpha_wide$richness_t2, paired = TRUE)
  meds.richness <- c(median(alpha_wide$richness_t1), median(alpha_wide$richness_t2))
  print(glue(
    "The group medians of RICHNESS:
     Baseline = {meds.richness[1]}
     Follow up = {meds.richness[2]}
     Abs median difference: {abs(diff(meds.richness))}
     The p value (Wilcoxon-paired): {p.richness$p.value}"
  ))

  return(list(p_shannon = p.shannon$p.value, 
              p_richness = p.richness$p.value)) 
}
```

```{r iterative modeling - function }

library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
 
## Build the function to apply across multiple variables 
iterative_modeling <- function(column_name, data_set, model_vars) {
  
  #drop any NA for the variable of interest
  data_set <- data_set %>%
    drop_na(!!sym(column_name)) #turn to symbol to ref
  
  # Calculate sample size N
  N <- nrow(data_set)
  
  #construct the formula with the changing column as the first predictor and covariates
  formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      #include backticks to allow special characters in the model formula
      "`", column_name, "` ~ case_con * collection_part + (1 | single_id)",
      #if covariates, add in, otherwise if unadjusted model add nothing
      if (length(model_vars) > 0) paste0("+", paste(model_vars, collapse = " + ")) else ""
      )
    )
  
  #fit the model
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    formula, 
    data = data_set
  )
  
  #print model summary for first taxa, enzyme, metabolite
  if (column_name %in% c("s__Escherichia_coli","`Genistein`","`1.1.1.62`","Genistein")) { #"`g_Blautia`",
    print(formula)
    print(summary(model))
  }
  
  #pull out results
  result <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)  %>%

    #filter to pull out rows of interest
    filter(term %in% c("case_con1:collection_part2"))%>% #"case_con1", 
    # Add feature name and clean term label
    mutate(feature = column_name) %>%
    select(feature, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
    # Create summary column
    mutate(
      estimate_CI = paste0(
        formatC(estimate, format = "f", digits = 2),     " (", 
        formatC(conf.low, format = "f", digits = 2), ", ",
        formatC(conf.high, format = "f", digits = 2), ")" 
      ), 
      term = ifelse(term=="case_con1", 
                    "Case Status", 
                    "Interaction")
    )
  
  #add col for sample size
  result$N <- N
  
  #return result
  return(result) 
  
}

## Build the function to apply across multiple variables 
iterative_modeling.therapy <- function(column_name, data_set, model_vars) {
  
  #Clean data
  data_set <- data_set %>%
    # SELECT CASES ONLY
    filter(case_con == 1) %>% 
    #drop any NA for the variable of interest
    drop_na(!!sym(column_name)) #turn to symbol to ref
  
  #factor data
  data_set$t_endo_drug.cat <- factor(data_set$t_endo_drug.cat,
                                       levels = c("None","Aromatase_inhibitor","Tamoxifen"))
  
  # Calculate sample size N
  N <- nrow(data_set)
  
  #construct the formula with the changing column as the first predictor and covariates
  formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      #include backticks to allow special characters in the model formula
      "`", column_name, "` ~ t_endo_drug.cat * collection_part + (1 | single_id)",
      #if covariates, add in, otherwise if unadjusted model add nothing
      if (length(model_vars) > 0) paste0("+", paste(model_vars, collapse = " + ")) else ""
      )
    )
  
  #fit the model
  model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    formula, 
    data = data_set
  )
  
  #print model summary for first taxa, enzyme, metabolite
  if (column_name %in% c("s__Escherichia_coli","`Genistein`","`1.1.1.62`","Genistein")) { #"`g_Blautia`",
    print(formula)
    print(summary(model))
  }
  
  #pull out results
  result <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)  %>%
    #filter to pull out rows of interest
    filter(term %in% c("t_endo_drug.catAromatase_inhibitor:collection_part2", "t_endo_drug.catTamoxifen:collection_part2"))%>%
    # Add feature name and clean term label
    mutate(feature = column_name) %>%
    select(feature, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
    # Create summary column
    mutate(
      estimate_CI = paste0(
        formatC(estimate, format = "f", digits = 2),     " (", 
        formatC(conf.low, format = "f", digits = 2), ", ",
        formatC(conf.high, format = "f", digits = 2), ")" 
      ), 
      term = ifelse(term=="t_endo_drug.catAromatase_inhibitor:collection_part2", 
                    "Interaction (A Inhibitor)", 
                    "Interaction(ER Blocker)")
    )
  
  #add col for sample size
  result$N <- N
  
  #return result
  return(result) 
  
}
```     

```{r iterative modeling - apply }

library(writexl)

## PRE DEFINE VARIABLES

#predictor_vars
#adjustment_sets 
#dataset.model


## APPLY THE FUNCTION 

apply_iterative.modeling <- function(predictor_vars, adjustment_sets, dataset.model, file_name) {
  
  #Create empty results list
  df_results <- list()
  
  #Loop through models for each adjustment level
  for (i in names(adjustment_sets) ) {
    
    #select what to include in the adjustment set
    model_vars = adjustment_sets[[i]]
    
    #Remove NA vars
    dataset.model <- dataset.model %>% 
      filter(if_all(all_of(model_vars), ~ !is.na(.)))
    
    #Apply the function to each column in the selected range and combine results
    log_model.results <- map_dfr(predictor_vars, function(column_name) {
      iterative_modeling(column_name = column_name,  #.therapy
                         data_set = dataset.model, 
                         model_vars = model_vars)
    }) 
    
    #Calculate a q value (FDR adjustment for multiple testing)
    log_model.results <- log_model.results %>% 
      group_by(term) %>% 
      mutate(q.value = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"), 3)) %>% 
      ungroup() %>%
      #clean up the names
      mutate(feature_clean = feature %>%
               gsub("\\.", " ", .) %>%           # Replace dots with spaces
               gsub("`", "", .) %>%              # Remove backticks
               sub("^[sgt]__", "", .) %>%        # Remove leading s__/g__/t__
               gsub("_", " ", .)                 # Replace underscores with spaces
             ) %>% 
      #sort
      select(feature_clean, term, estimate_CI, p.value, 
             q.value, N, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, feature) %>% 
      arrange(p.value)#term, feature_clean)
    
    #Store the result in the list with a dynamic sheet name
    df_results[[paste0("Sheet_", i)]] <- log_model.results
    
  } 
  
  #Save to Excel (multiple sheets)
  write_xlsx(df_results, sprintf("GLMMs_%s_%s.xlsx", file_name, as.character(Sys.Date())))

}

apply_iterative.modeling.therapy <- function(predictor_vars, adjustment_sets, dataset.model, file_name) {
  
  #Create empty results list
  df_results <- list()
  
  #Loop through models for each adjustment level
  for (i in names(adjustment_sets) ) {
    
    #select what to include in the adjustment set
    model_vars = adjustment_sets[[i]]
    
    #Remove NA vars
    dataset.model <- dataset.model %>% 
      filter(if_all(all_of(model_vars), ~ !is.na(.)))
    
    #Apply the function to each column in the selected range and combine results
    log_model.results <- map_dfr(predictor_vars, function(column_name) {
      iterative_modeling.therapy(column_name = column_name,  #.therapy
                         data_set = dataset.model, 
                         model_vars = model_vars)
    }) 
    
    #Calculate a q value (FDR adjustment for multiple testing)
    log_model.results <- log_model.results %>% 
      group_by(term) %>% 
      mutate(q.value = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"), 3)) %>% 
      ungroup() %>%
      #clean up the names
      mutate(feature_clean = feature %>%
               gsub("\\.", " ", .) %>%           # Replace dots with spaces
               gsub("`", "", .) %>%              # Remove backticks
               sub("^[sgt]__", "", .) %>%        # Remove leading s__/g__/t__
               gsub("_", " ", .)                 # Replace underscores with spaces
             ) %>% 
      #sort
      select(feature_clean, term, estimate_CI, p.value, 
             q.value, N, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, feature) %>% 
      arrange(p.value)
    
    #Store the result in the list with a dynamic sheet name
    df_results[[paste0("Sheet_", i)]] <- log_model.results
    
  } 
  
  #Save to Excel (multiple sheets)
  write_xlsx(df_results, sprintf("GLMMs_%s_%s.xlsx", file_name, as.character(Sys.Date())))

}
```

```{r metaphlan alpha diversity}
metaphlan.shannon <- alpha_data %>% 
  #reshape data
  mutate(case_con_sep = ifelse(case_con == 1, "Case", "Control"),
          group_label = case_when(
            case_con == 1 & collection_part == 1 ~ "B_Case",
            case_con == 1 & collection_part == 2 ~ "F_Case",
            case_con == 0 & collection_part == 1 ~ "B_Control",
            case_con == 0 & collection_part == 2 ~ "F_Control"
          )
         ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(shannon)) %>% #shannon #richness
  #plotting
  ggplot(aes(x = interaction(collection_part, case_con_sep), 
             y = shannon, #shannon #richness
             color = group_label,
             fill = group_label)) + 
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.2) +  # Jitter the points along the x-axis
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +  # Boxplots on top, with semi-transparent fill
      stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black", shape = 18) +  # Median points
      geom_line(stat = "summary", aes(group = case_con_sep), fun = median, color = "black") +  # Connect medians with lines
      scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1.Case" = "Baseline", 
                                  "2.Case" = "Follow-up", 
                                  "1.Control" = "Baseline",

      scale_color_manual(values = c("B_Case" = "#6ba",#"darkblue",
                                    "F_Case" = "darkblue",#"#6ba",
                                    "B_Control" = "wheat3",#"sienna",
                                    "F_Control" = "sienna"# "wheat3"

                                    "F_Case" = "darkblue",#"#6ba",
                                    "B_Control" = "wheat3",#"sienna",
                                    "F_Control" = "sienna"# "wheat3"
                                    ))+
      theme_minimal() +

        legend.position = "none" ,#"inside",
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.00),  # x and y (from bottom-left)
        #legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")

        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller

  # 🔹 Add p-value brackets
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("1.Case", "2.Case"), c("1.Control", "2.Control")),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    aes(label = sprintf("p = %.3f", ..p..)),   # format to 3 decimals
    size = 2.5,                                 # smaller text
    #label.y = c(4.4, 4.5),                    # adjust upward as needed
    tip.length = 0.01
  )

## Plotting Sig Testing RICHNESS ####

metaphlan.richness <- alpha_data %>% 
  #reshape data
  mutate(case_con_sep = ifelse(case_con == 1, "Case", "Control"),
          group_label = case_when(
            case_con == 1 & collection_part == 1 ~ "B_Case",
            case_con == 1 & collection_part == 2 ~ "F_Case",
            case_con == 0 & collection_part == 1 ~ "B_Control",
            case_con == 0 & collection_part == 2 ~ "F_Control"
          )
         ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(richness)) %>% #shannon #richness
  #plotting
  ggplot(aes(x = interaction(collection_part, case_con_sep), 
             y = richness, #shannon #richness
             color = group_label)) + 
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.2) +  # Jitter the points along the x-axis
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +  # Boxplots on top, with semi-transparent fill
      stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black", shape = 18) +  # Median points
      geom_line(stat = "summary", aes(group = case_con_sep), fun = median, color = "black") +  # Connect medians with lines
      scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1.Case" = "Baseline", 
                                  "2.Case" = "Follow-up", 
                                  "1.Control" = "Baseline", 
                                  "2.Control" = "Follow-up")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("B_Case" = "darkblue",
                                    "F_Case" = "#6ba",
                                    "B_Control" = "sienna",
                                    "F_Control" = "wheat3"),
                         guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none", #"inside",
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.00),  # x and y (from bottom-left)
        #legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9)   # makes the x-axis title smaller
      ) +
      labs(x = "Time Point",
           y = "Richness Index", #Shannon #Richness
           color = "Group")
``` 

```{r metaphlan beta diversity - significance testing}
## Regular PERMANOVA

#Cases vs controls at baseline
beta_data <- wgs_filter(metaphlan4_wide.t, collection_part, 1)

beta_dist <- beta_data %>% 
    column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
    as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
    vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan

groups <- merge(beta_data %>% select(plate_ID),
                gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, case_con, collection_part),
                by="plate_ID") %>% 
          pull(case_con) %>% 
          factor(levels = c("0","1"))

    column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
    as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
```

```{r metaphlan beta diversity - plotting overall}

## Calculate Bray-Curtis Distances
dist_mat <- metaphlan4_wide.t %>% 
    column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
    as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
    vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan


## Principal Component Analysis

beta_pcoa <- cmdscale(dist_mat, #pcoa is list with $points (PCs per sample)
                   k = 2, #N-1 PCs (default 2)
                   eig = TRUE, # $eig (explained variation), $x (null), $ac, $GOF
                   add = TRUE) #added add=T from Sandeep
#convert eigenvalues to percentage
beta_perc_exp <- 100 * beta_pcoa$eig / sum(beta_pcoa$eig)

#turn pcoa points from list to dataframe
beta_pcoa.df <- as.data.frame(beta_pcoa$points) %>% #turn list component to dataframe
  rownames_to_column(var = "plate_ID") %>% #study id stored as row_name
  rename_with(~paste0("PC", gsub("V", "", .)), starts_with("V")) %>% #col names from V to PC
  merge(gmbc_data, ., by="plate_ID") #merge PC values onto meta data



## Plotting

#create combined grouping var
beta_pcoa.df <- beta_pcoa.df %>% 
  mutate(
    group_label = case_when(
      case_con == 1 & collection_part == 1 ~ "Case, Baseline",
      case_con == 1 & collection_part == 2 ~ "Case, Follow-up",
      case_con == 0 & collection_part == 1 ~ "Control, Baseline",
      case_con == 0 & collection_part == 2 ~ "Control, Follow-up"
    )
  )

#calculate the median coordinates for each group
medians <- beta_pcoa.df %>%
  filter(case_con == 1 ) %>% 
  group_by(group_label) %>%
  summarize(
    med_PC1 = median(PC1), 
    med_PC2 = median(PC2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#set colours by group
group_colors <- c(
  "Case, Baseline" = "#6ba",#"darkblue",     # medium blue
  "Case, Follow-up" = "darkblue", #"#6ba",    # light blue
  "Control, Baseline" = "wheat3",#"sienna",  # dark grey
  "Control, Follow-up" = "sienna"#"wheat3"  # light grey
)

## Plotting PCOAs
metaphlan.beta_plot <- beta_pcoa.df %>% 
  # PART TWO SAMPLES ONLY
  filter(case_con == 1 ) %>% 
  #plotting
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group_label, shape = collection_part)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = group_label), level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.6) +
  #stat_ellipse(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2), level = 0.95) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +# c("0" = "darkgray", "1" = "blue")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("1" = 17, "2" = 16)) + #circle baseline #triangle FU
  labs(x = glue("PC 1 ({round(beta_perc_exp[1], digits = 1)}% exp var)"),
       #y = glue("Beta Diversityn/ PC 2 ({round(beta_perc_exp[2], digits = 1)}% exp var)"),
         y = paste0(
                "<span style='font-size:10pt'>Beta Diversity of Cases</span><br>",
                "<span style='font-size:8pt'>PC 2 (", round(beta_perc_exp[2], 1), "% exp var)</span>"
              ),
       color = "Case Status",
       shape = "Time Point") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", #"right",
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),   # makes the x-axis title smaller
        axis.title.y = element_markdown(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")) +
  #add lines from each point to the median of its group with matching colors
  geom_segment(data = beta_pcoa.df %>% 
                 left_join(medians, by = "group_label"),
               aes(x = med_PC1, y = med_PC2, xend = PC1, yend = PC2,
                   color = group_label),
               linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  #add median points with matching colors
  geom_point(data = medians, 
             aes(x = med_PC1, y = med_PC2, color = group_label), 
             size = 3, shape = 4, stroke = 1.15)   # Shape 4 is an 'x' marker


```

```{r humann pathways alpha diversity}
## Calculating the alpha diversity measures
alpha_data <- alpha_calc_data(humann.path_long)

## Significant testing

## Plotting Sig Testing SHANNON ####

path.shannon <- alpha_data %>% 
  #reshape data
  mutate(case_con_sep = ifelse(case_con == 1, "Case", "Control"),
          group_label = case_when(
            case_con == 1 & collection_part == 1 ~ "B_Case",
            case_con == 1 & collection_part == 2 ~ "F_Case",
            case_con == 0 & collection_part == 1 ~ "B_Control",
            case_con == 0 & collection_part == 2 ~ "F_Control"
          )
         ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(shannon)) %>% #shannon #richness
  #plotting
  ggplot(aes(x = interaction(collection_part, case_con_sep), 
             y = shannon, #shannon #richness
             color = group_label,
             fill = group_label)) + 
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.2) +  # Jitter the points along the x-axis
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +  # Boxplots on top, with semi-transparent fill
      stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black", shape = 18) +  # Median points
      geom_line(stat = "summary", aes(group = case_con_sep), fun = median, color = "black") +  # Connect medians with lines
      scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1.Case" = "Baseline", 
                                  "2.Case" = "Follow-up", 
                                  "1.Control" = "Baseline", 
                                  "2.Control" = "Follow-up")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("B_Case" = "#6ba",#"darkblue",
                                    "F_Case" = "darkblue",#"#6ba",
                                    "B_Control" = "wheat3",#"sienna",
                                    "F_Control" = "sienna"# "wheat3"
                                    ),
                         guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("B_Case" = "#6ba",#"darkblue",
                                    "F_Case" = "darkblue",#"#6ba",
                                    "B_Control" = "wheat3",#"sienna",
                                    "F_Control" = "sienna"# "wheat3"
                                    ))+
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none" ,#"inside",
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.00),  # x and y (from bottom-left)
        #legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10) 
      ) +
      labs(x = "Time Point",
           y = "Alpha Diversity (Shannon)", #Shannon #Richness
           color = "Group") +
  # 🔹 Add p-value brackets
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("1.Case", "2.Case"), c("1.Control", "2.Control")),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    aes(label = sprintf("p = %.3f", ..p..)),   # format to 3 decimals
    size = 2.5,                                 # smaller text
    label.y = c(5.6, 5.65),                    # adjust upward as needed
    tip.length = 0.01
  )

## Plotting Sig Testing RICHNESS ####

  #reshape data
```

```{r humann enzymes alpha diversity}
                                  "2.Case" = "Follow-up", 
                                  "1.Control" = "Baseline", 
                                  "2.Control" = "Follow-up")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("B_Case" = "#6ba",#"darkblue",
                                    "F_Case" = "darkblue",#"#6ba",
                                    "B_Control" = "wheat3",#"sienna",
                                    "F_Control" = "sienna"# "wheat3"
                                    ),
                         guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("B_Case" = "#6ba",#"darkblue",
                                    "F_Case" = "darkblue",#"#6ba",
                                    "B_Control" = "wheat3",#"sienna",
                                    "F_Control" = "sienna"# "wheat3"
                                    ))+
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none" ,#"inside",
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.00),  # x and y (from bottom-left)
        #legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10) 
      ) +
      labs(x = "Time Point",
           y = "Alpha Diversity (Shannon)", #Shannon #Richness
           color = "Group") +
  # 🔹 Add p-value brackets
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("1.Case", "2.Case"), c("1.Control", "2.Control")),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    aes(label = sprintf("p = %.3f", ..p..)),   # format to 3 decimals
    size = 2.5,                                 # smaller text
    label.y = c(6.55, 6.65),                    # adjust upward as needed
    tip.length = 0.01
  )

## Plotting Sig Testing RICHNESS ####

enzyme.richness <- alpha_data %>% 
  #reshape data
  mutate(case_con_sep = ifelse(case_con == 1, "Case", "Control"),
          group_label = case_when(
            case_con == 1 & collection_part == 1 ~ "B_Case",
            case_con == 1 & collection_part == 2 ~ "F_Case",
            case_con == 0 & collection_part == 1 ~ "B_Control",
            case_con == 0 & collection_part == 2 ~ "F_Control"
          )
         ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(richness)) %>% #shannon #richness
  #plotting
  ggplot(aes(x = interaction(collection_part, case_con_sep), 
             y = richness, #shannon #richness
             color = group_label)) + 
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.2) +  # Jitter the points along the x-axis
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +  # Boxplots on top, with semi-transparent fill
      stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black", shape = 18) +  # Median points
      geom_line(stat = "summary", aes(group = case_con_sep), fun = median, color = "black") +  # Connect medians with lines
      scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1.Case" = "Baseline", 
                                  "2.Case" = "Follow-up", 
                                  "1.Control" = "Baseline", 
                                  "2.Control" = "Follow-up")) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("B_Case" = "darkblue",
                                    "F_Case" = "#6ba",
                                    "B_Control" = "sienna",
                                    "F_Control" = "wheat3"),
                         guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none", #"inside",
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.00),  # x and y (from bottom-left)
        #legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9)   # makes the x-axis title smaller
      ) +
      labs(x = "Time Point",
           y = "Richness Index", #Shannon #Richness
           color = "Group")
```

```{r humann.enzyme beta diversity - significance testing}

## Regular PERMANOVA

#Cases vs controls at baseline
beta_data <- wgs_filter(humann.enzymes_wide, collection_part, 1)

beta_dist <- beta_data %>% 
    column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
    as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
    vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan

groups <- merge(beta_data %>% select(plate_ID),
                gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, case_con, collection_part),
                by="plate_ID") %>% 
          pull(case_con) %>% 
          factor(levels = c("0","1"))
adonis2(beta_dist ~ groups)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
adonis2(beta_dist ~ groups)$`R2`[1]


#cases vs controls at follow up
beta_data <- wgs_filter(humann.enzymes_wide, collection_part, 2)

beta_dist <- beta_data %>% 
    column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
    as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
    vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan

groups <- merge(beta_data %>% select(plate_ID),
                gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, case_con, collection_part),
                by="plate_ID") %>% 
          pull(case_con) %>% 
          factor(levels = c("0","1"))
adonis2(beta_dist ~ groups)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
adonis2(beta_dist ~ groups)$`R2`[1]


## PERMANOVA Accounting for Dependent Samples

#cases baseline vs cases follow up
beta_data <- wgs_filter(humann.enzymes_wide, case_con, 1)

beta_dist <- beta_data %>% 
    column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
    as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
    vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan

groups <- merge(beta_data %>% select(plate_ID),
                gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, case_con, collection_part, single_id),
                by="plate_ID") 

beta_results <- adonis2(beta_dist ~ 
                          groups %>% pull(collection_part) %>% factor(levels = c("1","2")), 
                        permutations = 999,
                        strata = groups$single_id,
                        method = "bray")
beta_results$`Pr(>F)`[1]
beta_results$`R2`[1]

#controls baseline vs controls follow up
beta_data <- wgs_filter(humann.enzymes_wide, case_con, 0)

beta_dist <- beta_data %>% 
    column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
    as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
    vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan

groups <- merge(beta_data %>% select(plate_ID),
                gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, case_con, collection_part, single_id),
                by="plate_ID") 

beta_results <- adonis2(beta_dist ~ 
                          groups %>% pull(collection_part) %>% factor(levels = c("1","2")), 
                        permutations = 999,
                        strata = groups$single_id,
                        method = "bray")
beta_results$`Pr(>F)`[1]
beta_results$`R2`[1]
```

```{r humann.enzyme beta diversity - plotting overall}

## Calculate Bray-Curtis Distances
dist_mat <- humann.enzymes_wide %>% 
    column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
    as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
    vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan


## Principal Component Analysis

beta_pcoa <- cmdscale(dist_mat, #pcoa is list with $points (PCs per sample)
                   k = 2, #N-1 PCs (default 2)
                   eig = TRUE, # $eig (explained variation), $x (null), $ac, $GOF
                   add = TRUE) #added add=T from Sandeep
#convert eigenvalues to percentage
beta_perc_exp <- 100 * beta_pcoa$eig / sum(beta_pcoa$eig)

#turn pcoa points from list to dataframe
beta_pcoa.df <- as.data.frame(beta_pcoa$points) %>% #turn list component to dataframe
  rownames_to_column(var = "plate_ID") %>% #study id stored as row_name
  rename_with(~paste0("PC", gsub("V", "", .)), starts_with("V")) %>% #col names from V to PC
  merge(gmbc_data, ., by="plate_ID") #merge PC values onto meta data



## Plotting

#calculate the median coordinates for each group
medians <- beta_pcoa.df %>%
  filter(case_con == 1) %>% 
  group_by(collection_part) %>%
  summarize(
    med_PC1 = median(PC1), 
    med_PC2 = median(PC2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Plotting PCOAs
enzyme.beta_plot <- beta_pcoa.df %>% 
  filter(case_con == 1) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = collection_part, shape = collection_part)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, stroke = 0, size = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = collection_part), level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("1" = 17, "2" = 16), guide = "none") + #circle baseline #triangle FU
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Time Point",           # legend title
    values = c("1" = "#6ba", "2" = "darkblue"),
    labels = c("1" = "Baseline", "2" = "Follow-up")
  ) +
  labs(x = glue("PC 1 ({round(beta_perc_exp[1], digits = 1)}% exp var)"),
       #y = glue("PC 2 ({round(beta_perc_exp[2], digits = 1)}% exp var)")
      y = paste0(
      "<span style='font-size:10pt'>Beta Diversity of Cases</span><br>",
      "<span style='font-size:8pt'>PC 2 (", round(beta_perc_exp[2], 1), "% exp var)</span>"
    ),
       ) + 
  ylim(-0.2, NA) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),   # makes the x-axis title smaller
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"),
        #LEGEND
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6.8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = c(0.99, 0.01),    # inside top left (x,y in npc)
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
        legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "lines"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"), 
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 0.1, r = 0.1, b = 0.1, l = 0.1, unit = "cm")
       ) +
  #add lines from each point to the median of its group with matching colors
  geom_segment(
    data = beta_pcoa.df %>% 
           filter(case_con == 1) %>%  # only follow-up points
           left_join(medians, by = "collection_part"),
    aes(x = med_PC1, y = med_PC2, xend = PC1, yend = PC2, color = collection_part),
    linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  #add median points with matching colors
  geom_point(data = medians, 
             aes(x = med_PC1, y = med_PC2, color = collection_part), 
             size = 3, shape = 4, stroke = 1.15)
```

Temporal Changes in Bray-Curtis Dissimilarities
        
```{r metaphlan beta diversity - intra-individual dissimilarity}

### Calculate Bray-Curtis Distances
dist_mat <- metaphlan4_wide.t %>% 
    column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
    as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
    vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan

### DATA PREPARATION

# Convert distance object to full matrix
beta_matrix <- as.matrix(dist_mat)


# Create a long-form dataframe of all pairwise distances

#Get all pairwise combinations
pairwise_df <- expand.grid(sample1 = rownames(beta_matrix), sample2 = colnames(beta_matrix)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%  # convert both to character
    filter(sample1 < sample2)  # avoid duplicates and diagonals

# Add distance values
pairwise_df$distance <- mapply(function(x, y) beta_matrix[x, y], 
                                pairwise_df$sample1, pairwise_df$sample2)


# Add subject IDs, collection_part, case_con for each sample
pairwise_df <- pairwise_df %>%
  left_join(gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, single_id, collection_part, case_con), by = c("sample1" = "plate_ID")) %>%
  rename(singleid1 = single_id,
         time1 = collection_part,
         case_con1 = case_con
         ) %>%
  left_join(gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, single_id, collection_part, case_con), by = c("sample2" = "plate_ID")) %>%
  rename(singleid2 = single_id,
         time2 = collection_part,
         case_con2 = case_con
         )



### CALCULATE WITHIN: Intra-Individual Dissimilarity (microbiome stability within indv over time)

# Filter out where ids match but different time points (data is symmetric)
intra_individual_df <- pairwise_df %>% 
  filter(singleid1 == singleid2, time1 != time2)

# Convert case_con to factor for nicer labels
intra_individual_df$case_con1 <- factor(intra_individual_df$case_con1, levels = c(1,0), labels = c("Cases", "Controls"))

# Plot boxplot
metaphlan.intraplot <- ggplot(intra_individual_df, aes(x = case_con1, y = distance, fill = case_con1, color=case_con1)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15), size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(x = NULL, #"Species", 
       y = "Intra-individual Dissimilarity") + #Bray-Curtis 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Controls" = "sienna", "Cases" = "darkblue")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Controls" = "sienna", "Cases" = "darkblue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10) 
        ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("Controls", "Cases")),
    method = "wilcox.test",    # or "t.test"
    aes(label = sprintf("p = %.3f", ..p..)),  # three decimals
    tip.length = 0.01,
    size = 2.5  
  )

metaphlan.intraplot
# Statistical comparison
wilcox.test(distance ~ case_con1, data = intra_individual_df)

# Median and IQR values

intra_individual_df %>%
  group_by(case_con1) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median = median(distance),
    IQR = IQR(distance),
    q25 = quantile(distance, 0.25),
    q75 = quantile(distance, 0.75)
  )



```

Volcano Plots
```{r GLMM genera - volcano plot}

## Read in data
glmms_results <- readxl::read_excel("GLMMs_genus_long_2025-10-08.xlsx", sheet = 2)

## Format data
glmms_results <- glmms_results %>%
  mutate(
    sig_color = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "1", "2")
    )

## Run plot
volcano.genus <- ggplot(glmms_results, aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(p.value)) ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig_color), alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "gray80") +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = Inf, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "darkblue", "2" = "grey70")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2.2, 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3.1)) +
  labs(
    x = "log(Fold Change)", #because of the log transformation
    y = "-log10(p value)",
    color = NULL, 
    title = "Genera"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

#volcano.genus
```

Relative Abundance Plot

```{r Relative abundance plots}

# Relevant Features
features <- c(
    "g__Christensenellaceae_unclassified", 
    "g__Faecalicatena",
    "s__Bifidobacterium_adolescentis|t__SGB17244_group", 
    "s__Coprococcus_eutactus|t__SGB5117",
    "s__Intestinibacter_bartlettii|t__SGB6140", 
    "1.1.1.64",
    "3.4.13.21",
    "3.5.1.82",
    "PWY-5850: superpathway of menaquinol-6 biosynthesis",
    "PWY-5860: superpathway of demethylmenaquinol-6 biosynthesis I",
    "PWY-5896: superpathway of menaquinol-10 biosynthesis"
  )


# select from each datatype
estro.t <- metaphlan4_wide.t %>% select(plate_ID, any_of(features))
estro.g <- metaphlan4_wide.g %>% select(plate_ID, any_of(features))
estro.e <- humann.enzymes_wide %>% select(plate_ID, any_of(features))
estro.p <- humann.path_wide %>% select(plate_ID, any_of(features))
#merge all together
estro.full <- estro.t %>% 
  left_join(estro.g, by="plate_ID") %>% 
  left_join(estro.e, by="plate_ID") %>% 
  left_join(estro.p, by="plate_ID")
    
# Prep data
estro.full <- estro.full %>% 
  #clean up names
  rename(
    "Christensenellaceae unclass." = "g__Christensenellaceae_unclassified", 
    "Faecalicatena" = "g__Faecalicatena",
    "Bifidobacterium adolescentis" = "s__Bifidobacterium_adolescentis|t__SGB17244_group", 
    "Coprococcus eutactus" = "s__Coprococcus_eutactus|t__SGB5117", 
    "Intestinibacter bartlettii" = "s__Intestinibacter_bartlettii|t__SGB6140", 
    "Testosterone dehyd. (1.1.1.64)"="1.1.1.64",
    "Dipeptidase E (3.4.13.21)" = "3.4.13.21",
    "N-a-D-G deacylase (3.5.1.82)" = "3.5.1.82",
    "menaquinol-6 B (5850)" = "PWY-5850: superpathway of menaquinol-6 biosynthesis",
    "demethylmenaquinol-6 B (5860)" = "PWY-5860: superpathway of demethylmenaquinol-6 biosynthesis I",
    "menaquinol-10 B (5896)" = "PWY-5896: superpathway of menaquinol-10 biosynthesis"
  ) %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, case_con, collection_part), by="plate_ID") %>% 
  mutate(
    group_label = case_when(
      case_con == 1 & collection_part == 1 ~ "Case, Baseline",
      case_con == 1 & collection_part == 2 ~ "Case, Follow-up",
      case_con == 0 & collection_part == 1 ~ "Control, Baseline",
      case_con == 0 & collection_part == 2 ~ "Control, Follow-up"
    )
  ) %>% 
  #long form data
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(plate_ID, group_label, case_con, collection_part),     # which columns to reshape
    names_to = "Feature",              # new column for old column names
    values_to = "relative_abundance"             # new column for values
  ) %>% 
  #remove zeros so not clogging the plot
  filter(relative_abundance > 0) %>% 
  #log transform for visualization on plot
  mutate(log_rel_abundance = log10(relative_abundance))

## Colours
color_values = c(
      "Case, Baseline" = "#6ba",
      "Case, Follow-up" = "darkblue",
      "Control, Baseline" = "wheat3",
      "Control, Follow-up" = "sienna"
    )

## Order for the plot
estro.full <- estro.full %>% 
  mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels = 
      c("Christensenellaceae unclass.", "Faecalicatena",
        "Bifidobacterium adolescentis", "Coprococcus eutactus","Intestinibacter bartlettii",
        "Testosterone dehyd. (1.1.1.64)","Dipeptidase E (3.4.13.21)","N-a-D-G deacylase (3.5.1.82)",
        "menaquinol-6 B (5850)","demethylmenaquinol-6 B (5860)","menaquinol-10 B (5896)"
        )
   ))

## Beta value
estro.full <- estro.full %>% 
  mutate(beta_coef = case_when(
    Feature == "Christensenellaceae unclass." ~ "β = 1.79", 
    Feature == "Faecalicatena" ~ "β = -1.64",
    Feature == "Bifidobacterium adolescentis" ~ "β = -2.15",
    Feature == "Coprococcus eutactus" ~ "β = -0.85",
    Feature == "Intestinibacter bartlettii" ~ "β = 1.39",
    Feature == "Testosterone dehyd. (1.1.1.64)" ~ "β = -0.88",
    Feature == "Dipeptidase E (3.4.13.21)" ~ "β = -1.81",
    Feature == "N-a-D-G deacylase (3.5.1.82)" ~ "β = 1.71",
    Feature == "menaquinol-6 B (5850)" ~ "β = -1.33",
    Feature == "demethylmenaquinol-6 B (5860)" ~ "β = -1.26",
    Feature == "menaquinol-10 B (5896)" ~ "β = -1.25",
    TRUE ~ NA ))

## Beta value positions
B_position <- estro.full %>% 
  group_by(Feature, beta_coef) %>% 
  summarize(x_pos = max(log_rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.15, .groups = "drop")


## Plotting
rel_abun.plot <- ggplot(estro.full, aes(y=fct_rev(Feature), x=log_rel_abundance, color=group_label)) +
  #adding in the individual rel_abun points
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.8,
                                              jitter.width = 0.1),
              shape=21, alpha = 0.2) +
  #boxplots per group per species
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(Feature, group_label), fill = group_label),
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
               alpha = 0.35,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  #manually setting colours of the groups
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL, values = color_values) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = color_values) +
  labs(y=NULL, x="log10(Relative Abundance)") +
  xlim(NA, 2.25) +
  # Add annotations for metadata term
  geom_text(data = B_position,
            aes(x = x_pos, y = Feature, label = beta_coef),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "black") +
  #overall theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_markdown(size=9),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.text = element_markdown(),
        legend.position = c(0.025, 0.82),
        legend.justification = c(0, 1), 
        legend.background = element_rect(color="black", fill = NA),
        legend.margin = margin(t=1, r=3, b=3)
  )

rel_abun.plot
## Save file
ggsave(
  filename = "/Users/ashlarnder/Downloads/relabun_2025-10-27.png",   # file name
  plot = rel_abun.plot,                   # which plot to save
  width = 6.5,                  # width
  height = 6,                 # height
  units = "in",               # units: "in", "cm", or "mm"
  dpi = 600                   # resolution
)
```

### ENDOCRINE SUBGROUP ANALYSIS

#### Diversity Measures
 
Alpha Diversity          
```{r stratified alpha diversity - species}
 
library(ggpubr)

## DATA PREP ####

## Calculating the alpha diversity measures
alpha_data <- alpha_calc_data(metaphlan4_long, metaphlan=TRUE) %>% 
   #Add in therapy type data
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, t_endo_drug.cat), by="plate_ID") %>% 
  #Filter to cases only
  filter(case_con == 1) %>% 
  #get it so groups are labeled as I want
  mutate(
    t_endo_drug.cat = factor(t_endo_drug.cat, 
                               levels = c("None", "Aromatase_inhibitor", "Tamoxifen"),
                               labels = c("None", "AI", "Tamoxifen")),
    collection_part = factor(collection_part, labels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up"))
  )

## Significant testing

# format wider
delta_df <- alpha_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(shannon)) %>%
  select(single_id, t_endo_drug.cat, collection_part, shannon) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = collection_part, values_from = shannon) %>%
  mutate(delta = `Follow-up` - Baseline)

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(delta ~ t_endo_drug.cat, data = delta_df)
p_val <- kruskal_res$p.value

## Plotting SHANNON two rows ####

metaphlan.shannon <- ggplot(alpha_data, aes(x = t_endo_drug.cat, y = shannon, 
                                            color = t_endo_drug.cat, fill = t_endo_drug.cat)) + 
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.2) +  # Jitter the points along the x-axis
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +  # Boxplots on top, with semi-transparent fill
      #stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black", shape = 18) +  # Median points
      facet_wrap(~ collection_part, ncol = 1) +  # stack Baseline on top, Follow-up below
  
      #geom_line(stat = "summary", aes(group = t_endo_drug.cat), fun = median, color = "black") +  # Connect medians with lines
      scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "None" = "darkgrey",
        "A Inhibitor" = "sienna",
        "ER Blocker" = "darkblue"
      )) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "None" = "darkgrey",
        "A Inhibitor" = "sienna",
        "ER Blocker" = "darkblue"
      )) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none" ,#"inside",
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.00),  # x and y (from bottom-left)
        #legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),   # makes the x-axis title smaller
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10) 
      ) +
      labs(x = "Species",
           y = "Shannon Index")

#metaphlan.shannon


## Plotting Delta SHANNON ####

dshannon.species <- ggplot(delta_df, 
       aes(x = t_endo_drug.cat, y = delta, 
           color = t_endo_drug.cat, fill = t_endo_drug.cat)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +  # Boxplots on top, with
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "None" = "darkgrey",
        "AI" = "sienna",
        "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue"
      )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "None" = "darkgrey",
        "AI" = "sienna",
        "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue"
      )) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 2,
           y = min(delta_df$delta) + 0.15,  # slightly above your data
           label = paste0("Kruskal–Wallis p = ", signif(p_val, 3)),
           size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Δ Shannon Index") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none" ,#"inside",
    #legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.00),  # x and y (from bottom-left)
    #legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7.5),   # makes the tick labels smaller
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),   # makes the tick labels smaller
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),   # makes the x-axis title smaller
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10) 
  )
``` 

```{r stratified alpha diversity - enzymes}
alpha_data <- alpha_calc_data(humann.enzymes_long) %>% 
   #Add in therapy type data
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, t_endo_drug.cat), by="plate_ID") %>% 
  #Filter to cases only
  filter(case_con == 1) %>% 
  #get it so groups are labeled as I want
  mutate(
    t_endo_drug.cat = factor(t_endo_drug.cat, 
                               levels = c("None", "Aromatase_inhibitor", "Tamoxifen"),
                               labels = c("None", "AI", "Tamoxifen")),
    collection_part = factor(collection_part, labels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up"))
  )

## Significant testing

# format wider
delta_df <- alpha_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(shannon)) %>%
  select(single_id, t_endo_drug.cat, collection_part, shannon) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = collection_part, values_from = shannon) %>%
  mutate(delta = `Follow-up` - Baseline)
 
kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(delta ~ t_endo_drug.cat, data = delta_df)
p_val <- kruskal_res$p.value
 
## Plotting Sig Testing SHANNON ####

enzyme.shannon <- ggplot(alpha_data, aes(x = t_endo_drug.cat, y = shannon, 
                                            color = t_endo_drug.cat, fill = t_endo_drug.cat)) + 
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.2) +  # Jitter the points along the x-axis
      geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA) +  # Boxplots on top, with semi-transparent fill
      #stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3, color = "black", shape = 18) +  # Median points
      facet_wrap(~ collection_part, ncol = 1) +  # stack Baseline on top, Follow-up below
  
      #geom_line(stat = "summary", aes(group = t_endo_drug.cat), fun = median, color = "black") +  # Connect medians with lines
      scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "None" = "darkgrey",
        "A Inhibitor" = "sienna",
        "ER Blocker" = "darkblue"
      )) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "None" = "darkgrey",
        "A Inhibitor" = "sienna",
        "ER Blocker" = "darkblue"
      )) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none" ,#"inside",
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.00),  # x and y (from bottom-left)
        #legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),   # makes the tick labels smaller
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),   # makes the x-axis title smaller
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10) 
      ) +
      labs(x = "Enzymes",
           y = "Shannon Index")

#enzyme.shannon


## Plotting Delta SHANNON ####

dshannon.enzyme <- ggplot(delta_df, 
       aes(x = t_endo_drug.cat, y = delta, 
           color = t_endo_drug.cat, fill = t_endo_drug.cat)) +
``` 

Beta Diversity    
```{r stratified beta diversity - species}
 
## Data Prep ####

## Calculate Bray-Curtis Distances
dist_mat <- metaphlan4_wide.t %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, case_con, collection_part), by="plate_ID") %>% 
  filter(case_con == 1, collection_part==2) %>% #select cases only at follow-up
  select(!c(case_con, collection_part)) %>% 
  arrange(plate_ID) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
  as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
  vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan

## Significance testing
levels(gmbc_data$t_endo_drug.cat) <- c("AI", "None", "Tamoxifen")
groups <- gmbc_data %>%
  arrange(plate_ID) %>%  
  filter(case_con == 1, collection_part == 2) %>%
  pull(t_endo_drug.cat)
adonis2(dist_mat ~ groups)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
adonis2(dist_mat ~ groups)$`R2`[1]


## Principal Component Analysis
beta_pcoa <- cmdscale(dist_mat, #pcoa is list with $points (PCs per sample)
                   k = 2, #N-1 PCs (default 2)
                   eig = TRUE, # $eig (explained variation), $x (null), $ac, $GOF
                   add = TRUE) #added add=T from Sandeep
#convert eigenvalues to percentage
beta_perc_exp <- 100 * beta_pcoa$eig / sum(beta_pcoa$eig)
#turn pcoa points from list to dataframe
beta_pcoa.df <- as.data.frame(beta_pcoa$points) %>% #turn list component to dataframe
  rownames_to_column(var = "plate_ID") %>% #study id stored as row_name
  rename_with(~paste0("PC", gsub("V", "", .)), starts_with("V")) %>% #col names from V to PC
  merge(., gmbc_data, by="plate_ID") #merge PC values onto meta data


# Rename factor levels
beta_pcoa.df$t_endo_drug.cat = as.factor(beta_pcoa.df$t_endo_drug.cat)
levels(beta_pcoa.df$t_endo_drug.cat) <- c("AI", "None", "Tamoxifen")

# Calculate the median coordinates for each group
medians <- beta_pcoa.df %>%
  group_by(t_endo_drug.cat) %>% #t_endo_drug.cat #t_rad_dose.cat
  summarize(
    med_PC1 = median(PC1), 
    med_PC2 = median(PC2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Plotting PCOAs ####

metaphlan.beta_plot <- beta_pcoa.df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = t_endo_drug.cat)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=0.5, stroke = 0, size = 2) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = t_endo_drug.cat), level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "AI" = "sienna", 
    "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue",
    "None" = "darkgrey"
  )) +
  labs(x = glue("PC 1 ({round(beta_perc_exp[1], digits = 1)}% exp var)"),
       #y = glue("PC 2 ({round(beta_perc_exp[2], digits = 1)}% exp var)"),
       y = paste0(
       "<span style='font-size:10pt'>Beta Diversity of Cases</span><br>",
       "<span style='font-size:8pt'>PC 2 (", round(beta_perc_exp[2], 1), "% exp var)</span>"),
       color = "Endocrine Therapy") + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),   # makes the tick labels smaller
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),   # makes the x-axis title smaller
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(),
    legend.position = "none",#"right",
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")
    ) +
  #add lines from each point to the median of its group with matching colors
  geom_segment(data = beta_pcoa.df %>% 
                 left_join(medians, by = "t_endo_drug.cat"),
               aes(x = med_PC1, y = med_PC2, xend = PC1, yend = PC2,
                   color = t_endo_drug.cat),
               linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  #add median points with matching colors
  geom_point(data = medians, 
             aes(x = med_PC1, y = med_PC2, color = t_endo_drug.cat), 
             size = 3, shape = 4, stroke = 1.15)  # Shape 4 is an 'x' marker

```

Beta Dissimilarity
```{r stratified beta dissimilarity - species}
 
### DATA PREPARATION ####

# Calculate Bray-Curtis Distances (cases only)
dist_mat <- metaphlan4_wide.t %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, case_con), by="plate_ID") %>% 
  filter(case_con == 1) %>% #select cases only at follow-up
  select(!c(case_con)) %>% 
  arrange(plate_ID) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
  as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
  vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan

# Convert distance object to full matrix
beta_matrix <- as.matrix(dist_mat)

# Get all pairwise combinations
pairwise_df <- expand.grid(sample1 = rownames(beta_matrix), sample2 = colnames(beta_matrix)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%  # convert both to character
    filter(sample1 < sample2)  # avoid duplicates and diagonals

# Add distance values
pairwise_df$distance <- mapply(function(x, y) beta_matrix[x, y], 
                                pairwise_df$sample1, pairwise_df$sample2)

# Add subject IDs, collection_part, case_con for each sample
pairwise_df <- pairwise_df %>%
  left_join(gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, single_id, collection_part, t_endo_drug.cat), 
            by = c("sample1" = "plate_ID")) %>%
  rename(singleid1 = single_id,
         time1 = collection_part,
         t_endo_drug.cat1 = t_endo_drug.cat) %>%
  left_join(gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, single_id, collection_part, t_endo_drug.cat), 
            by = c("sample2" = "plate_ID")) %>%
  rename(singleid2 = single_id,
         time2 = collection_part,
         t_endo_drug.cat2 = t_endo_drug.cat)



### CALCULATE WITHIN: Intra-Individual Dissimilarity (microbiome stability within indv over time)

# Filter out where ids match but different time points (data is symmetric)
intra_individual_df <- pairwise_df %>% 
  filter(singleid1 == singleid2, time1 != time2)

# Convert case_con to factor for nicer labels
intra_individual_df$t_endo_drug.cat1 <- as.factor(intra_individual_df$t_endo_drug.cat1)
levels(intra_individual_df$t_endo_drug.cat1) <- c("AI", "None", "Tamoxifen")
intra_individual_df <- intra_individual_df %>% 
  mutate(t_endo_drug.cat1 = factor(t_endo_drug.cat1, levels = 
        c("None", "AI", "Tamoxifen")
     ))

# Statistical comparison
kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(distance ~ t_endo_drug.cat1, data = intra_individual_df)
p_val <- kruskal_res$p.value


# Plot boxplot ####

metaphlan.intraplot <- ggplot(intra_individual_df, aes(x = t_endo_drug.cat1, y = distance, fill = t_endo_drug.cat1, color=t_endo_drug.cat1)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Intra-individual Dissimilarity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "None" = "darkgrey", 
    "AI" = "sienna", 
    "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "None" = "darkgrey", 
    "AI" = "sienna", 
    "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue")) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 2,
           y = max(intra_individual_df$distance) + 0.05,  # slightly above your data
           label = paste0("Kruskal–Wallis p = ", signif(p_val, 3)),
           size = 2.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10) 
        )

metaphlan.intraplot



# Median and IQR values ####

intra_individual_df %>%
  group_by(t_endo_drug.cat1) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median = median(distance),
    IQR = IQR(distance),
    q25 = quantile(distance, 0.25),
    q75 = quantile(distance, 0.75)
  )

```
