```{r stratified beta dissimilarity - path}
  filter(singleid1 == singleid2, time1 != time2)

# Convert case_con to factor for nicer labels
intra_individual_df$t_endo_drug.cat1 <- as.factor(intra_individual_df$t_endo_drug.cat1)
levels(intra_individual_df$t_endo_drug.cat1) <- c("AI", "None", "Tamoxifen")
intra_individual_df <- intra_individual_df %>% 
  mutate(t_endo_drug.cat1 = factor(t_endo_drug.cat1, levels = 
        c("None", "AI", "Tamoxifen")
     ))



# Statistical comparison

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(distance ~ t_endo_drug.cat1, data = intra_individual_df)
p_val <- kruskal_res$p.value

# Plot boxplot ####

path.intraplot <- ggplot(intra_individual_df, aes(x = t_endo_drug.cat1, y = distance, fill = t_endo_drug.cat1, color=t_endo_drug.cat1)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Intra-individual Dissimilarity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "None" = "darkgrey", 
    "AI" = "sienna", 
    "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "None" = "darkgrey", 
    "AI" = "sienna", 
    "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue")) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 2,
           y = max(intra_individual_df$distance) + 0.025,  # slightly above your data
           label = paste0("Kruskal–Wallis p = ", signif(p_val, 3)),
           size = 2.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10) 
        )

  group_by(t_endo_drug.cat1) %>%
```

```{r stratified beta dissimilarity - enzyme}
 
### DATA PREPARATION ####

# Calculate Bray-Curtis Distances (cases only)
dist_mat <- humann.enzymes_wide %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, case_con), by="plate_ID") %>% 
  filter(case_con == 1) %>% #select cases only at follow-up
  select(!c(case_con)) %>% 
  arrange(plate_ID) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("plate_ID") %>% #turning column values to name
  as.matrix() %>% #convert to matrix
  vegdist(method = "bray") #calc bray-curtis matrix of distances using vegan

# Convert distance object to full matrix
beta_matrix <- as.matrix(dist_mat)

# Get all pairwise combinations
pairwise_df <- expand.grid(sample1 = rownames(beta_matrix), sample2 = colnames(beta_matrix)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%  # convert both to character
    filter(sample1 < sample2)  # avoid duplicates and diagonals

# Add distance values
pairwise_df$distance <- mapply(function(x, y) beta_matrix[x, y], 
                                pairwise_df$sample1, pairwise_df$sample2)

# Add subject IDs, collection_part, case_con for each sample
pairwise_df <- pairwise_df %>%
  left_join(gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, single_id, collection_part, t_endo_drug.cat), 
            by = c("sample1" = "plate_ID")) %>%
  rename(singleid1 = single_id,
         time1 = collection_part,
         t_endo_drug.cat1 = t_endo_drug.cat) %>%
  left_join(gmbc_data %>% select(plate_ID, single_id, collection_part, t_endo_drug.cat), 
            by = c("sample2" = "plate_ID")) %>%
  rename(singleid2 = single_id,
         time2 = collection_part,
         t_endo_drug.cat2 = t_endo_drug.cat)



### CALCULATE WITHIN: Intra-Individual Dissimilarity (microbiome stability within indv over time)

# Filter out where ids match but different time points (data is symmetric)
intra_individual_df <- pairwise_df %>% 
  filter(singleid1 == singleid2, time1 != time2)

# Convert case_con to factor for nicer labels
intra_individual_df$t_endo_drug.cat1 <- as.factor(intra_individual_df$t_endo_drug.cat1)
levels(intra_individual_df$t_endo_drug.cat1) <- c("AI", "None", "Tamoxifen")

  mutate(t_endo_drug.cat1 = factor(t_endo_drug.cat1, levels = 
        c("None", "AI", "Tamoxifen")
     ))


# Statistical comparison

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(distance ~ t_endo_drug.cat1, data = intra_individual_df)
p_val <- kruskal_res$p.value 

# Plot boxplot ####

enzyme.intraplot <- ggplot(intra_individual_df, aes(x = t_endo_drug.cat1, y = distance, fill = t_endo_drug.cat1, color=t_endo_drug.cat1)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1), size = 2, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Intra-individual Dissimilarity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "None" = "darkgrey", 
    "AI" = "sienna", 
    "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "None" = "darkgrey", 
    "AI" = "sienna", 
    "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue")) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 2,
           y = max(intra_individual_df$distance) + 0.025,  # slightly above your data
           label = paste0("Kruskal–Wallis p = ", signif(p_val, 3)),
           size = 2.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
```

Volcano Plotting
```{r GLMM genera - volcano plot}

## Read in data
glmms_results <- readxl::read_excel("GLMMs_genus_long-therapy_2025-10-08.xlsx", sheet = 2)

## Format data
glmms_results <- glmms_results %>%
  mutate(
    term = ifelse(term == "Interaction (A Inhibitor)", 
                  "Interaction (AI)",
                  "Interaction (tamoxifen)"),
    sig_color = case_when(
      (term == "Interaction (AI)" & p.value < 0.05) ~ "1",
      (term == "Interaction (tamoxifen)" & p.value < 0.06) ~ "2",
      TRUE ~ "3"),
    alpha_val = ifelse(q.value < 0.25, 0.9, 0.4)
    )

## Run plot
volcano.genus <- ggplot(glmms_results, aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(p.value),
                                           shape = term) ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig_color, alpha = alpha_val), 
             size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", alpha=0.8, color = "gray80") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.001), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "sienna", 
                                "2" = "darkblue",
                                "3" = "grey70")) +
  scale_alpha_identity() +  # use exact alpha values
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2.9, 4.48)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3.6)) +
  labs(
    x = "log(Fold Change)", #because of the log transformation
    y = "-log10(p value)",
    color = NULL, 
    title = "Genera"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

Relative Abundance Plot

```{r Relative abundance plots - NEW}

library(patchwork)

# Relevant Features
features <- c(
  "s__GGB33928_SGB15225|t__SGB15225",  
  "PYRIDNUCSAL-PWY: NAD salvage pathway I (PNC VI cycle)",
  "PWY3O-4107: NAD salvage pathway V (PNC V cycle)",
  "P105-PWY: TCA cycle IV (2-oxoglutarate decarboxylase)"
)

# Select from each datatype
estro.t <- metaphlan4_wide.t %>% select(plate_ID, any_of(features))
estro.e <- humann.enzymes_wide %>% select(plate_ID, any_of(features))
estro.p <- humann.path_wide %>% select(plate_ID, any_of(features))

# Merge all together
estro.full <- estro.t %>% 
  left_join(estro.e, by="plate_ID") %>% 
  left_join(estro.p, by="plate_ID")

# Clean and reshape
estro.long <- estro.full %>% 
  #clean up the data
  rename(
    "GGB33928 SGB15225" = "s__GGB33928_SGB15225|t__SGB15225",  
    "TCA cycle IV (P105-PWY)"= "P105-PWY: TCA cycle IV (2-oxoglutarate decarboxylase)",
    "NAD salvage pathway I (PYRIDNUCSAL-PWY)"= "PYRIDNUCSAL-PWY: NAD salvage pathway I (PNC VI cycle)",
    "NAD salvage pathway V (PWY3O-4107)" = "PWY3O-4107: NAD salvage pathway V (PNC V cycle)"
  ) %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% 
          select(plate_ID, single_id, case_con, collection_part, t_endo_drug.cat), 
        by="plate_ID") %>% 
  filter(case_con == "1") %>% 
  mutate(t_endo_drug.cat1 = factor(t_endo_drug.cat, 
                  levels = c("None", "Aromatase_inhibitor", "Tamoxifen"),
                  labels = c("None", "AI", "Tamoxifen"))
  ) %>% 
  # Pivot to long form to prepare for delta calculation
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(plate_ID,single_id, case_con, collection_part, t_endo_drug.cat, t_endo_drug.cat1),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "relative_abundance"
  ) %>% 
  filter(relative_abundance > 0)

# Pivot wider
estro.delta <- estro.long %>%
  select(single_id, Feature, relative_abundance, collection_part, t_endo_drug.cat1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(single_id, Feature, t_endo_drug.cat1),
    names_from = collection_part,
    values_from = relative_abundance,
    names_prefix = "Time"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Time1 = ifelse( is.na(Time1), 0, Time1),
    Time2 = ifelse( is.na(Time2), 0, Time2),
    delta_abundance = Time2 - Time1
    ) %>% 
  mutate(Group = ifelse(Feature == "GGB33928 SGB15225", "Species", "Pathways"))

# Factor levels for Features (for plotting)
estro.delta <- estro.delta %>% 
  mutate(Feature = factor(Feature, levels = c(
    "TCA cycle IV (P105-PWY)",
    "NAD salvage pathway I (PYRIDNUCSAL-PWY)",
    "NAD salvage pathway V (PWY3O-4107)",
    "GGB33928 SGB15225"
  ))) 

# Colours
color_values = c(
  "None" = "grey",
  "AI" = "sienna",
  "Tamoxifen" = "darkblue"
)



# Subset your data by facet variable
top_data <- subset(estro.delta, Group == "Pathways")   # replace with your actual facet name
bottom_data <- subset(estro.delta, Group == "Species")

  
p1 <- ggplot(top_data, 
       aes(y = fct_rev(Feature), x = delta_abundance,
           color = t_endo_drug.cat1, fill = t_endo_drug.cat1)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~Group, scales = "free", ncol=1) +
  xlim(c(-7e-05,7e-05)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_values, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_values, name = NULL) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = "Δ Relative Abdundance (Follow-up − Baseline)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_markdown(),
    legend.position = c(0.8, 0.95),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 1, r = 3, b = 3),
    strip.text = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
    color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  )

# reuse same plot but with other facet data
p2 <- p1 %+% bottom_data  + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = NULL) +   # removes inherited xlim()
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8)) 

# Combine with heights 3:1
combined_plot <- p1 / p2 + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))

combined_plot



## Save file

)
```

## METABOLOMICS

Summary 
```{r Summary}

## Characterizing metabolites (zero-count, median non-zero val)

#Function 
metabo_characterize  <- function(metabo_data) {
  #Total number of metabolites
  print(glue("The total number of metabolites: {ncol(metabo_data)-1}"))
  
  #Calculate number zeros per metabolite and non-zero val
  metabo_data %>%
    #add in case_con val from metadata
    left_join(gmbc_data %>% select(study_id, case_con), by="study_id") %>% 
    #reshape
    pivot_longer(-c(study_id, case_con), names_to = "Metabolite", values_to = "relab") %>%
    group_by(Metabolite) %>%
    summarise(
      # Median of non-zero values
      median_nonzero = median(relab[relab > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
      # Count of zero values
      zero_count = sum(relab == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Count non-zero in cases and controls
      n_case_nonzero = sum(relab > 0 & case_con == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_control_nonzero = sum(relab > 0 & case_con == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      #mean and SD
      mean_nonzero = mean(relab, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_nonzero = sd(relab, na.rm = TRUE),
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(zero_count)) %>% 
    mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ gsub("\\.", " ", .))) %>% 
  select(Metabolite, zero_count, n_case_nonzero, mean_nonzero, sd_nonzero) %>% 
    view()
}

#Apply
metabo_characterize(plasma_abund)
metabo_characterize(stool_abund)

in_both <- intersect(names(metabo.plasma_wide), names(metabo.stool_wide))  # Common columns
view(in_both)
```

Multi-level PLS-DA   
```{r Multi-level PLS-DA - plasma }

#library(ropls)
library(mixOmics)
library(dplyr)

## Prepare Data ####

#dataset
oplsda <- metabo.plasma_wide %>% 
  transform_metabo(., remove_outliers = F, merge = F) %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% dplyr::select(study_id, single_id, case_con, collection_part), by="study_id")

# predictors (metabolites)
X <- oplsda %>% dplyr::select(-c(case_con, study_id, single_id, collection_part)) %>% as.matrix()
# outcome variable (e.g., case vs. control)
Y <- as.factor(oplsda$case_con)  
# subject ids for repeated measures
subject <- oplsda$single_id

## Run multilevel PLS-DA (accounts for repeated measures)
plsda_model <- plsda(X, Y, multilevel = subject, ncomp = 2)


## REPORT FEATURES/PERFORMANCE ####

# ## Important Variables
# vipVn.plasma <- vip(plsda_model) %>%   # Variable Importance in Projection (VIP) scores
#   as.data.frame() %>% 
#   arrange(desc(.))
# # write.csv(vipVn.plasma, "/Users/ashlarnder/Downloads/vip.plasma.csv", row.names = TRUE)
# head(vipVn.plasma, 10)


## Explained variance
plsda_model$prop_expl_var$X

# Run repeated cross-validation for mPLS-DA
perf_mplsda <- perf(
  plsda_model,
  validation = "Mfold",
  folds = 5,
  nrepeat = 5,
  dist = "centroids.dist"
)

# Classification error rates
# Overall classification error per component
perf_mplsda$error.rate$overall
# Balanced error rate (BER)
perf_mplsda$error.rate$BER


## Scores Plotting ####

#predictive component scores
scores <- plsda_model$variates$X
#including group labels
scores <- data.frame(
    comp1 = scores[, 1],
    comp2 = scores[, 2],
    case_con = Y,
    time = oplsda$collection_part,
    ID = subject
  ) %>% 
  mutate(group_label = case_when(
      case_con == 1 & time == 1 ~ "Case, Baseline",
      case_con == 1 & time == 2 ~ "Case, Follow-up",
      case_con == 0 & time == 1 ~ "Control, Baseline",
      case_con == 0 & time == 2 ~ "Control, Follow-up"
  ))
#get explained variance for predictive components
expl_var <- plsda_model$prop_expl_var$X

#calculate the median coordinates for each group
medians <- scores %>%
  group_by(group_label) %>%
  summarize(
    med_comp1 = median(comp1), 
    med_comp2 = median(comp2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#set colours by group
group_colors <- c(
  "Case, Baseline" = "darkblue",     # medium blue
  "Case, Follow-up" = "#6ba",    # light blue
  "Control, Baseline" = "sienna",  # dark grey
  "Control, Follow-up" = "wheat3" 
)


#build the plot
pls_plot.plasma <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = comp1, y = comp2, 
                                      color = group_label, shape = time)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.6) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = group_label), level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +# c("0" = "darkgray", "1" = "blue")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("1" = 16, "2" = 17)) + #circle baseline #triangle FU
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(   
    x = paste0("Component 1 (", round(expl_var[[1]], 2), "% exp var)"),
    y = paste0("Component 2 (", round(expl_var[[2]], 2), "% exp var)"),
    color = "Case_Status",
    shape = "Time Point"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",#"right",
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")) +
  
  #add lines from each point to the median of its group with matching colors
  geom_segment(data = scores %>% 
                 left_join(medians, by = "group_label"),
               aes(x = med_comp1, y = med_comp2, xend = comp1, yend = comp2,
                   color = group_label),
               linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  #add median points with matching colors
  geom_point(data = medians, 
             aes(x = med_comp1, y = med_comp2, color = group_label), 
             size = 2.5, shape = 4, stroke = 1.2)  # Shape 4 is an 'x' marker

pls_plot.plasma


```

```{r plasma metabolites - volcano plot}
               glmms_results$sig_color == "2" ~ 0.5

  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "darkblue","1" = "darkblue", "2" = "grey70")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3.85, 3.57)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.105)) +
  labs(
    x = "log2(Fold Change)", #because of the log transformation
    y = "-log10(p value)",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Plasma Metabolites"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
    text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

Relative Abundance Plots
```{r plasma metabolites - relabun plot}

## Read in the data

glmms_results <- readxl::read_excel("GLMMs_metabo.plasma_long_2025-07-15.xlsx") %>% 
  #remove last two cols because model printed info
  select(1:(ncol(.) - 2)) %>% 
  mutate(metadata = fct_recode(term,
                      "Case status" = "case_con1",
                      "Time point" = "collection_part2",
                      "Interaction (case*time)" = "case_con1:collection_part2") )

features <- glmms_results %>% filter(q.value < 0.25) %>% distinct(feature) %>% pull(feature)

## Metaphlan data
glmms_data <- metabo.plasma_long %>% 
  filter(Metabolite %in% features) %>% 
  select(study_id, Metabolite, relative_abundance) %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% select(study_id, single_id, collection_part, case_con), by="study_id") %>% 
  mutate(case_con = factor(case_con, 
                           levels = c(0, 1), 
                           labels = c('Control', 'Case')),
         collection_part = factor(collection_part, 
                                  levels = c(1, 2), 
                                  labels = c("Baseline", "Follow-up")),
         group = paste(case_con, collection_part)
  ) %>% 
  merge(., glmms_results %>% filter(q.value <0.25) %>% select(feature, metadata), by.x="Metabolite", by.y="feature")


## Select relevant features to plot
glmms_data.plot <- glmms_data %>% 
  filter(Metabolite %in% c(
    #interaction term
    "Estrone.3-sulfate",
    "Zymostenol", 	
    "Adipoyl-carnitine",
    #previous key findings
    "16a-Hydroxyestrone",
    "Matairesinol",
    "Genistein",
    "Pinoresinol",
    "Estriol.(E3)",
    "Glycoursodeoxycholic acid",
    "Hyocholic acid 3-sulfate",
    "3-Methylglutaryl-carnitine"
  )) %>% 
  #clean up names
  mutate(Metabolite = Metabolite %>%
          sub("^[sgt]__", "", .) %>%         # Remove leading s__/g__/t__
          gsub("[_.]", " ", .)                 # Replace underscores with spaces
    ) %>% 
  #filter out zero vals
  filter(relative_abundance > 0) %>% 
  #log transform for visualization on plot
  mutate(log_rel_abundance = log10(relative_abundance + 1e-6))

## Colours
color_values = c(
      "Control Baseline" = "grey30",
      "Case Baseline" = "blue4",
      "Control Follow-up" = "grey60",
      "Case Follow-up" = "skyblue"
    )


# Label positions per metabolite
metabolite_labels <- glmms_data.plot %>%
  group_by(Metabolite, metadata) %>%
  summarize(x_pos = max(log_rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.2, .groups = "drop")


## Plotting
ggplot(glmms_data.plot, aes(y=Metabolite, x=log_rel_abundance, color=group)) +
  #adding in the individual rel_abun points
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.8,
                                              jitter.width = 0.1),
              shape=21, alpha = 0.25) +
  #boxplots per group per species
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = interaction(Metabolite, group), fill = group),
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
               alpha = 0.5,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  # Add annotations for metadata term
  geom_text(data = metabolite_labels,
            aes(x = x_pos, y = Metabolite, label = metadata),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "black") +
  labs(y=NULL, x="log10(Relative Abundance)") +
  #manually setting colours of the groups
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL, values = color_values) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = color_values) +
  #overall theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_markdown(),
        legend.text = element_markdown(),
        #legend.position = leg_pos,
        legend.background = element_rect(color="black", fill = NA),
        legend.margin = margin(t=1, r=3, b=3))
```

### ENDOCRINE SUBGROUP ANALYSIS


Multi-level PLS-DA   
```{r mPLS-DA therapy - plasma }

#library(ropls)
library(mixOmics)
library(dplyr)

## Prepare Data ####

gmbc_data$t_endo_drug.cat <- factor(gmbc_data$t_endo_drug.cat,
                                       levels = c("None","Aromatase_inhibitor","Tamoxifen"),
                                      labels = c("None","A Inhibitor","ER Blocker"))

#dataset
oplsda <- metabo.plasma_wide %>% 
  transform_metabo(., remove_outliers = F, merge = F) %>% 
  merge(., gmbc_data %>% dplyr::select(study_id, single_id, case_con, collection_part, t_endo_drug.cat), by="study_id") %>% 
  ## FILTER CASES ONLY
  filter(case_con == 1) %>% 
  select(-case_con) 

# predictors (metabolites)
X <- oplsda %>% dplyr::select(-c(study_id, single_id, collection_part,t_endo_drug.cat)) %>% as.matrix()
# outcome variable (e.g., case vs. control)
Y <- as.factor(oplsda$t_endo_drug.cat)  
# subject ids for repeated measures
subject <- oplsda$single_id


## Run multilevel PLS-DA (accounts for repeated measures)
plsda_model <- plsda(X, Y, multilevel = subject, ncom = 2)



## PRINT FEATURES / PERFORMANCE ####

# ## Important Variables
# vipVn.plasma <- vip(plsda_model) %>%   # Variable Importance in Projection (VIP) scores
#   as.data.frame() %>%
#   arrange(desc(.))
# write.csv(vipVn.plasma, "/Users/ashlarnder/Downloads/vip.plasma-therapy.csv", row.names = TRUE)
# head(vipVn.plasma, 10)


## Explained variance
plsda_model$prop_expl_var$X

# Run repeated cross-validation for mPLS-DA
perf_mplsda <- perf(
  plsda_model,
  validation = "Mfold",
  folds = 5,
  nrepeat = 5,
  dist = "centroids.dist"
)

# Classification error rates
# Overall classification error per component
perf_mplsda$error.rate$overall
# Balanced error rate (BER)
perf_mplsda$error.rate$BER

## Scores Plotting ####

#predictive component scores
scores <- plsda_model$variates$X
#including group labels
scores <- data.frame(
    comp1 = scores[, 1],
    comp2 = scores[, 2],
    t_endo_drug.cat = Y,
    time = oplsda$collection_part,
    ID = subject
  ) %>% 
  mutate(group_label = case_when(
      t_endo_drug.cat == "None" & time == 1 ~ "None, Baseline",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "None" & time == 2 ~ "None, Follow-up",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "A Inhibitor" & time == 1 ~ "A Inhibitor, Baseline",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "A Inhibitor" & time == 2 ~ "A Inhibitor, Follow-up",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "ER Blocker" & time == 1 ~ "ER Blocker, Baseline",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "ER Blocker" & time == 2 ~ "ER Blocker, Follow-up",
  ))
#get explained variance for predictive components
expl_var <- plsda_model$prop_expl_var$X

#calculate the median coordinates for each group
medians <- scores %>%
  group_by(group_label) %>%
  summarize(
    med_comp1 = median(comp1), 
    med_comp2 = median(comp2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#set colours by group
group_colors <- c(
    "None, Baseline" = "black",
    "None, Follow-up" = "darkgrey",
    "A Inhibitor, Baseline"= "sienna",  
    "A Inhibitor, Follow-up" = "wheat3",
    "ER Blocker, Baseline"= "darkblue", 
    "ER Blocker, Follow-up" = "#6ba"    
)


#build the plot
pls_plot.plasma <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = comp1, y = comp2, 
                                      color = group_label, shape = time)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.6) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = group_label), level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +# c("0" = "darkgray", "1" = "blue")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("1" = 16, "2" = 17)) + #circle baseline #triangle FU
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(   
    x = paste0("Component 1 (", round(expl_var[[1]], 2), "% exp var)"),
    y = paste0("Component 2 (", round(expl_var[[2]], 2), "% exp var)"),
    color = "Case_Status",
    shape = "Time Point"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",#"right",
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")) +
  
  #add lines from each point to the median of its group with matching colors
  geom_segment(data = scores %>% 
                 left_join(medians, by = "group_label"),
               aes(x = med_comp1, y = med_comp2, xend = comp1, yend = comp2,
                   color = group_label),
               linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  #add median points with matching colors
  geom_point(data = medians, 
             aes(x = med_comp1, y = med_comp2, color = group_label), 
             size = 2.5, shape = 4, stroke = 1.2)  # Shape 4 is an 'x' marker

pls_plot.plasma



```

```{r mPLS-DA therapy - stool }
# predictors (metabolites)
X <- oplsda %>% dplyr::select(-c(study_id, single_id, collection_part,t_endo_drug.cat)) %>% as.matrix()
# outcome variable (e.g., case vs. control)
Y <- as.factor(oplsda$t_endo_drug.cat)  
# subject ids for repeated measures
subject <- oplsda$single_id


## Run multilevel PLS-DA (accounts for repeated measures)
plsda_model <- plsda(X, Y, multilevel = subject, ncom = 2)



# PRINT FEATURES / PERFORMANCE ####

## Explained variance
plsda_model$prop_expl_var$X

# Run repeated cross-validation for mPLS-DA
perf_mplsda <- perf(
  plsda_model,
  validation = "Mfold",
  folds = 5,
  nrepeat = 5,
  dist = "centroids.dist"
)

# Classification error rates
# Overall classification error per component
perf_mplsda$error.rate$overall
# Balanced error rate (BER)
perf_mplsda$error.rate$BER

## Scores Plotting ####

#predictive component scores
scores <- plsda_model$variates$X
#including group labels
scores <- data.frame(
    comp1 = scores[, 1],
    comp2 = scores[, 2],
    t_endo_drug.cat = Y,
    time = oplsda$collection_part,
    ID = subject
  ) %>% 
  mutate(group_label = case_when(
      t_endo_drug.cat == "None" & time == 1 ~ "None, Baseline",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "None" & time == 2 ~ "None, Follow-up",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "A Inhibitor" & time == 1 ~ "A Inhibitor, Baseline",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "A Inhibitor" & time == 2 ~ "A Inhibitor, Follow-up",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "ER Blocker" & time == 1 ~ "ER Blocker, Baseline",
      t_endo_drug.cat == "ER Blocker" & time == 2 ~ "ER Blocker, Follow-up",
  ))
#get explained variance for predictive components
expl_var <- plsda_model$prop_expl_var$X

#calculate the median coordinates for each group
medians <- scores %>%
  group_by(group_label) %>%
  summarize(
    med_comp1 = median(comp1), 
    med_comp2 = median(comp2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#set colours by group
group_colors <- c(
    "None, Baseline" = "black",
    "None, Follow-up" = "darkgrey",
    "A Inhibitor, Baseline"= "sienna",  
    "A Inhibitor, Follow-up" = "wheat3",
    "ER Blocker, Baseline"= "darkblue", 
    "ER Blocker, Follow-up" = "#6ba"    
)


#build the plot
pls_plot.stool <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = comp1, y = comp2, 
                                     color = group_label, shape = time)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.6) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = group_label), level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("1" = 16, "2" = 17)) +  # baseline = circle, FU = triangle
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(-7, NA) +
  labs(   
    x = paste0("Component 1 (", round(expl_var[[1]], 2), "% exp var)"),
    y = paste0("Component 2 (", round(expl_var[[2]], 2), "% exp var)"),
    color = NULL,
    shape = NULL  # remove separate shape title
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    # LEGEND
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = c(0.03, 0.2), #0.01, 0.999
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
    legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white"),
    legend.margin  = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.7, "lines"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"), 
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE, order = 1,
      override.aes = list(shape = c(16, 17)) # all shapes same in legend
    ),
    shape = "none"  # remove separate shape legend
  ) +
  geom_segment(data = scores %>% left_join(medians, by = "group_label"),
               aes(x = med_comp1, y = med_comp2, xend = comp1, yend = comp2,
                   color = group_label),
               linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = medians, 
             aes(x = med_comp1, y = med_comp2, color = group_label), 
             size = 2.5, shape = 4, stroke = 1.2)
```

```{r plasma metabolites - volcano plot}

## Read in the data
glmms_results <- readxl::read_excel("GLMMs_metabo.plasma_long-therapy_2025-09-23.xlsx", sheet = 2)

## Format data
glmms_results <- glmms_results %>%
  mutate(
    sig_color = case_when(
      (term == "Interaction (A Inhibitor)" & p.value < 0.05) ~ "1",
      (term == "Interaction(ER Blocker)" & p.value < 0.05) ~ "2",
      TRUE ~ "3"),
    term = ifelse(term=="Interaction (A Inhibitor)", "A Inhibitor","ER Blocker")
    )

## Run plot
volcano.plasma <- ggplot(glmms_results, aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(p.value)) ) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = term, color = sig_color), alpha = 0.9, size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("A Inhibitor" = 16, "ER Blocker" = 17)) + # circle & triangle
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" = "sienna", "2" = "darkblue", "3" = "grey70")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-6.36, 5.15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4.48)) +
  labs(
    x = "log2(Fold Change)", #because of the log transformation
    y = "-log10(p value)",
    color = NULL, #"Significance",
    shape = "Interactions",
    title = "Plasma"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
    text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "none"#"right",
  )

volcano.plasma
```
